title: Fundamentals in Healthcare Management
description: Core management ideas and tools applied to health, pharma and biotech organisations, taught through lectures and group case studies.
assessment: 50% in-class work (cases and presentations) and 50% final written exam (multiple choice and open questions). For non-attending students the exam counts 100%.
textbooks: Gomez-Mejia, L. R., Balkin, D. B. & Cardy, R. L. (2012). Management. McGraw-Hill.
Collis, D. J. & Montgomery, C. A. (2005). Corporate Strategy: A Resource-Based Approach (2nd ed.). McGraw-Hill.
Hill, C. W. Global Business Today (11th ed.). McGraw-Hill.
